# Compare CoreLink vs other remote caches

> **DRAFT — pending Legal + Finance + Security review.** This page reports
> publicly documented capabilities of each project. We do not disparage
> alternatives; correctness wins over rhetoric. If you find a factual error,
> open an issue.

## Scope

The remote-cache space spans open-source self-hosted projects and managed
services. The comparison below is limited to projects that implement the
Bazel/REAPI **Remote Cache** profile (ContentAddressableStorage + ActionCache
+ Capabilities). Remote-execution-only projects are out of scope.

## Capability matrix

| Capability | CoreLink | BuildBuddy | NativeLink | EngFlow | Self-hosted bazel-remote |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Managed multi-tenant SaaS | ✓ | ✓ | partial | ✓ | — |
| Self-hosted option | — | ✓ | ✓ | — | ✓ |
| REAPI CAS + AC | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Multi-region storage pinning | ✓ | varies | varies | ✓ | depends |
| BYOK (customer-managed KMS) | ✓ (Enterprise) | varies | varies | varies | depends |
| Append-only audit chain (RFC 6962) | ✓ | varies | varies | varies | — |
| SLSA L3 provenance on releases | ✓ | varies | varies | varies | — |
| Open source license | partial (CLI + SDK) | source-available | Apache-2.0 | proprietary | Apache-2.0 |
| Public pricing | `$X` per [tier](./) | varies | n/a | contact sales | n/a |

> "varies" means the project's public documentation does not commit to a
> single answer at the time of writing. Open an issue if you have a
> correction.

## What CoreLink optimizes for

- **Multi-tenant blast-radius control.** Tenant isolation is invariant-checked
  with a TLA+ model and enforced at every trust boundary
  (`security_model.md §3`).
- **Audit-grade retention.** Seven-year append-only audit log with RFC 6962
  inclusion proofs is on by default for Business and Enterprise tiers.
- **Supply-chain visibility.** Every release ships a Sigstore provenance
  attestation that can be verified against the public transparency log.

## What CoreLink does not aim to do

- We do not replace self-hosted remote-execution clusters. Remote execution
  (RBE) is a roadmap item beyond GA Phase 1.
- We do not undercut self-hosted operators on price for hobbyist workloads.
  The Free tier is intentionally bounded.
